The transaction is expected to close in the second half of 2027.

This suggests the AI boom has a stronger economic foundation than the internet bubble.

FMCC.title: StoneX and DeltaTerra Develop New Synthetic Structure for Agency Credit Risk Transfer

Foshee, Jr. and will lead the company's innovation initiatives across the Cardiac Recovery System platform, including AI applications and strategic partnerships.

SWMR.title: Swarmer Enters Into Definitive Agreement to Acquire Ratel Robotics, a Leading Ukrainian Unmanned Ground Vehicle Manufacturer, for Up to $224 Million
SWMR.summary: Swarmer, Inc. (NASDAQ: SWMR) announced a definitive agreement to acquire Ratel Robotics, a leading Ukrainian unmanned ground vehicle manufacturer, for up to $224 million in cash and stock. The acquisition combines Swarmer's combat-proven autonomy software with Ratel's battle-tested UGV platform, expanding the company's capabilities in autonomous systems. Ratel has secured $86 million in contracts this year and operates with NATO certification. The combined entity will employ approximately 500 people.

North America leads with 41% market share, while Asia-Pacific shows the fastest growth at 12.32% CAGR. Key innovations include bispecific antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates, with humanized antibodies emerging as the fastest-growing segment.

LLY.summary: Novo Nordisk announced positive phase III STEP Young study results showing semaglutide reduced BMI in children aged 6-12 with obesity, with 40.4% no longer classified as obese after 68 weeks. LLY.title: Lilly Builds Neuroscience into a New Long-Term Growth Driver
LLY.summary: Eli Lilly's neuroscience business, currently representing only 2% of revenues, is experiencing strong 32% growth with key products Kisunla and Emgality. The company is aggressively expanding its neuroscience pipeline through acquisitions including AtaiBeckley for treatment-resistant depression therapies, positioning neuroscience as a potential long-term growth driver to diversify beyond its dominant cardiometabolic business.

LLY.title: Cloverleaf Bio Raises $33 Million Seed Financing to Advance Novel RNA-Based Cancer Therapeutics
LLY.summary: Cloverleaf Bio, a Yale spinout RNA therapeutics company, closed a $33 million oversubscribed seed round led by 4BIO Capital with strategic participation from AbbVie Ventures, Eli Lilly, and Boehringer Ingelheim Venture Fund. The funding will advance the company's engineered tRNA platform for cancer treatment, with lead programs targeting hepatocellular carcinoma and colorectal cancer. Preclinical data shows the platform demonstrates superior potency and selectivity for cancer cells over healthy tissue.

LLY.title: Radioligand Therapy Market to Grow from USD 2.98 Billion in 2025 to USD 15.85 Billion by 2035, at a CAGR of 18.2% - SNS Insider
LLY.summary: The radioligand therapy market is projected to grow at an 18.2% CAGR through 2035, driven by increased prostate cancer and neuroendocrine tumor cases, FDA approvals for PSMA-targeted therapies like Pluvicto, and expanded isotope production capacity. BMY.title: Will The Recent Pipeline Progress Boost BMY's Portfolio Expansion?
BMY.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb announced positive Phase II results for arlo-cel, a first-in-class GPRC5D-directed CAR T cell therapy, in heavily pretreated multiple myeloma patients. This positions BMY to treat patients resistant to BCMA-directed therapies, broadening its multiple myeloma portfolio alongside recently approved Zenbexus.

BMY.title: SOTYKTU Clinical, Regulatory and Commercial Intelligence Report 2026
BMY.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb's SOTYKTU (deucravacitinib), a first-in-class TYK2 inhibitor, has received FDA approval for psoriatic arthritis in March 2026, expanding its commercial potential beyond plaque psoriasis. The drug demonstrates sustained efficacy with PASI 75 response rates of 67%-73% through five years and over 5,000 patient-years of safety data. Market analysis forecasts SOTYKTU sales across seven major markets through 2034, with growth driven by oral convenience, selective mechanism of action, and potential expansion into additional immune-mediated inflammatory disease indications including lupus, Sjogren's syndrome, and Crohn's disease.

The Power segment drove margin strength with a 52.9% revenue increase and improved gross margins to 22.4%. However, Industrial revenues doubled but margins fell to 7.3% due to worsening project completion estimates. Management expects Industrial margins to remain below historical norms for another 1-2 quarters.

However, the company faces margin pressure with gross margins declining from 25% to 19.3%, and trades at a premium 31.1X forward earnings. While growth signals remain favorable, execution risks and uncertain project timing present challenges to justify the current valuation.

NOW.summary: UiPath shares dropped 24% following Q2 fiscal 2027 results that beat revenue expectations and included raised full-year guidance. SSRM.summary: SSR Mining Inc. (SSRM) is advancing growth initiatives at its Marigold mine in Nevada, including the Buffalo Valley project, with an updated life-of-mine plan expected by end of 2026. The company expects 2026 Marigold production of 170,000-200,000 ounces, heavily weighted to Q4 with higher grades driving output. The stock trades at a forward P/E of 9.55x, below industry average, with 2026 earnings consensus of $3.87/share (+92.5% YoY), though recent estimates have declined.

CELH.title: Portnoy Law Firm Announces Class Action on Behalf of Celsius Holdings, Inc. Investors
CELH.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Celsius Holdings (NASDAQ: CELH) on behalf of investors who purchased securities between February 21, 2025 and June 3, 2026. The complaint alleges that Celsius failed to disclose that its acquired Alani Nutrition drinks contain excessive caffeine (200mg per 12oz serving) and pose cardiac risks, particularly to minors under 18 whom the company allegedly targeted despite safety concerns. Investors have until November 3, 2026 to file a lead plaintiff motion.

WPC.title: Is Realty Income's 5.3% Yield Still Compelling? Buy or Hold the Stock?
WPC.summary: Realty Income's 5.3% dividend yield offers only a modest 50 basis point premium over the 10-year Treasury yield, raising questions about its attractiveness. With a forward P/FFO multiple of 13.45X and expected 4% AFFO growth, the stock lacks room for valuation expansion unless interest rates decline or growth accelerates. The analyst recommends a Hold rating for current shareholders while suggesting potential buyers wait for better entry points.

SMPL.title: Deadline Alert: Simply Good Foods Company (SMPL) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
SMPL.summary: Simply Good Foods Company (SMPL) faces a class action securities fraud lawsuit alleging the company made false statements about its OWYN acquisition between October 2024 and April 2026. The lawsuit claims management failed to disclose product quality issues from a new pea protein supplier, loss of key personnel, excessive promotional activities, and severe integration problems that caused OWYN sales to contract 17% year-over-year. The stock declined significantly following earnings announcements in October 2025 and April 2026, with a $187 million impairment charge taken against OWYN assets.

AMFL.title: SKY BLUE CINEMATIX - ENTERTAINMENT - BRAND INTEGRATION : Two Films. One Global Partnership.
AMFL.summary: Sky Blue Cinematix has been appointed as the exclusive worldwide brand-integration partner for two upcoming feature films from Tested Films: the action thriller 'Habeas Corpus' and the neo-noir romantic mystery 'Blurred', both directed by Ben Cookson. ELVN.title: Chronic Myeloid Leukemia Clinical Trial Pipeline Appears Robust With 25+ Key Pharma Companies Actively Working in the Domain | DelveInsight
ELVN.summary: The chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) clinical trial pipeline shows robust activity with 25+ pharmaceutical companies developing 25+ pipeline drugs. Key players including Merck, Enliven Therapeutics, ImmunoForge, and others are advancing promising therapies like TERN-701, ELVN-001, and KF1601 across various clinical stages. The market is evolving from established tyrosine kinase inhibitors toward newer selective agents targeting resistance, intolerance, and treatment-free remission.

SMR.summary: NuScale Power is leveraging its small modular reactors to produce carbon-free hydrogen for industrial applications. A six-module plant could generate 250-270 metric tons of hydrogen daily, with reactors positioned near industrial users to reduce transportation costs. The technology offers flexibility to shift between electricity and hydrogen production while complementing renewable energy sources.

MGCLY.summary: Midea highlights how modern inverter-driven cold-climate heat pumps and dual-fuel systems provide Canadian homeowners with flexible alternatives to aging HVAC equipment. VSH.title: Vishay Intertechnology 45 mm Inductive Position Sensor Encoder Enables Reliable Operation Near Electric Motors
VSH.summary: Vishay Intertechnology introduced the MCB RAIK045I MP, a 45mm inductive position sensor encoder offering 16-bit resolution, ≥14-bit repeatability, and operation up to 10,000 rpm. The device is immune to external magnetic fields, making it suitable for use near electric motors in industrial applications including robotics, motor drives, conveyor systems, and agricultural equipment. Samples and production quantities are available with 16-week lead times.

BEN.title: Stoneshield Capital se alía con Franklin Templeton y Clarion Partners
BEN.summary: Franklin Templeton, through its subsidiary Clarion Partners, has agreed to acquire a majority stake in Stoneshield Capital, a leading European real assets manager with €8 billion under management. The acquisition will triple Clarion's European AUM to €11 billion, increase total Clarion AUM by 12% to €72 billion, and boost Franklin Templeton's total alternative assets above $300 billion. Stoneshield specializes in thematic real assets investments across residential, student housing, digital infrastructure, science and innovation, hospitality, and critical infrastructure sectors. The transaction is expected to close in Q4 2026.

HON.title: Building Automation System Market
HON.summary: The building automation system market is undergoing structural transformation as hardware commoditizes while software, analytics, and building intelligence capture strategic value. The global BAS market, valued at $105.5 billion in 2026, is projected to reach $182.6 billion by 2033 at 8.2% CAGR. Key shifts include portfolio-level standardization replacing building-by-building procurement, cloud-based deployments displacing on-premise architectures, and cybersecurity becoming a primary procurement criterion. Large commercial owners are consolidating vendor relationships over the next 18 months, creating compounding advantages for early movers while independent system integrators face consolidation pressure.

AMWL.title: Amwell Receives Letter of Intent from Department of Veterans Affairs to Help Power its Digital Health Infrastructure
AMWL.summary: Amwell announced that the Department of Veterans Affairs has declared its intent to deploy Amwell's virtual health platform across the VA enterprise to modernize its digital health infrastructure and serve over nine million Veteran beneficiaries. The Letter of Intent follows a comprehensive VA evaluation that determined Amwell's platform aligns with the Department's strategic objectives, particularly in scalable video consultations, interoperability, cybersecurity compliance, and integrated care delivery. However, the Letter of Intent is non-binding and any formal agreement is contingent upon contract negotiation and federal procurement requirements.

DTIL.title: CPTx appoints Matt Kane as Chief Financial Officer
DTIL.summary: CPTx announced the appointment of Matt Kane as Chief Financial Officer. Kane brings extensive experience in gene editing and cell therapy, with a track record of raising over $500 million in equity financing and securing strategic partnerships valued at over $4 billion. He previously served as CEO of Celyad Oncology, Tune Therapeutics, and Precision Biosciences. Kane will lead CPTx's financing and partnering activities as the company advances its non-viral DNA-based in vivo CAR T therapies toward clinical studies.

ROIV.title: Dr. Gillian Cannon Joins Lindus Therapeutics’ Board as a Non-Executive Director
ROIV.summary: Lindus Therapeutics, a drug development company focused on in-licensed assets, has appointed Dr. Gillian Cannon as a non-executive director. Cannon brings over 30 years of biopharmaceutical commercial leadership experience from roles at Merck and Roivant Sciences. She will help shape the company's commercial strategy as it builds its portfolio of clinical-stage assets.

EDIT.title: Editas Medicine Appoints Dan Ory, M.D., as Chief Medical Officer
EDIT.summary: Editas Medicine announced the appointment of Dan Ory, M.D., as Chief Medical Officer effective September 8, 2026. Dr. Ory brings over 25 years of experience in cardiovascular and genetic medicine, previously serving as CMO at Arbor Biotechnologies and Casma Therapeutics. He will oversee clinical development strategy as Editas advances EDIT-401, its lead in vivo gene editing candidate for hyperlipidemia treatment, toward clinical trials.

SGIOY.title: Infex Therapeutics presents new Phase IIa data for RESP-X at ERS Congress 2026, providing further evidence on exploratory efficacy endpoints supporting progression to later stage development
SGIOY.summary: Infex Therapeutics announced Phase IIa data for RESP-X, a first-in-class anti-virulence monoclonal antibody targeting Pseudomonas aeruginosa in non-cystic fibrosis bronchiectasis patients. The drug demonstrated a significant reduction in annualized exacerbation rates from 3.4 to 1.2, with only one exacerbation meeting clinical criteria observed across all treated patients. The data supports progression to a larger efficacy study.

NBP.title: NovaBridge Appoints Martin Dewhurst to Board of Directors as an Independent Director
NBP.summary: NovaBridge Biosciences announced the appointment of Martin Dewhurst, a veteran healthcare executive with over 30 years of experience, to its Board of Directors as an independent director and member of both the Audit and Compensation Committees. Dewhurst brings extensive governance and strategic expertise from his tenure at McKinsey & Company and multiple board positions across biotech, biopharma, and healthcare companies.
